verdict.rationale: Retrieving call recordings and transcripts is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence pack never documents an API for fetching stored recordings or per-call transcripts. Twilio/WebSocket audio streaming, CLI file transcription, and MIP data retention are adjacent features, not programmatic per-call recording or transcript retrieval.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call
